query: 安全管理体系（ISO 45001） 安全管理体系（ISO 45001） 衡量职业健康安全体系认证覆盖和有效性。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：通过了 ISO 45001（或同等 OHSAS 18001）体系认证，且披露了内外部审核频率、安全风险识别机制及具体的职业病预防成效。 • 1分（合格）：建立了内部安全管理制度，具备基础的安全生产操作规程，但尚未获得第三方认证，或认证已过期但仍有管理动作。 • 0分（不合格）：无体系认证且无明确的安全管理制度披露。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：体系认证覆盖 >80% 的生产场地、实体数量、营业收入或员工人数（即你原始定义的 3分/4分 区间）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对生产部门认证而忽略了物流/行政部门，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关认证覆盖信息。 职业健康安全管理体系 职业病预防 认证覆盖率 安全生产管理体系 ISO 45001 OHSAS 18001 ISO 45001 OHSAS 18001 occupational health and safety management system OHS certification occupational disease prevention certification coverage 企业是否通过ISO 45001或同等OHSAS 18001认证？ 认证机构、证书有效期与认证范围是什么？ 认证覆盖多少生产场地、实体、营收或员工？ 是否披露内外部审核频率？ 是否披露安全风险识别机制及职业病预防成效？

[Content]
In order to strengthen the requirements of safety, environmental protection and occupational health management, the Group has established longterm management mechanism of Health, Safety and Environment (HSE). In 2021, the Group has formulated regulatory documents such as t h e Accident and Incident Management System ( 《事故事件管理制度》 ), the Insurance Management System and the Safety Reward ( 《安全獎懲及問責制度》 ), and the Punishment and Accountability System ( 《 保 險管理制度》 ) to standardize the basic management of safety and environment in project companies and strive to enhance the autonomous control ability of project companies.

results.text: The Group continues to pay attention to the health of employees and strengthens the implementation of occupational disease prevention and screening. We require new employees to take a physical examination and present the physical examination report before employment, and regularly organize in-service employees to take occupational health examinations. We strengthen occupational health management at each project site, continuously improve occupational disease prevention measures with protective masks, gas masks, goggles, safety helmets and other protective equipment and guide employees to use them correctly. In addition, we have installed more monitoring and alarm equipment in areas with greater occupational health risks to monitor toxic and harmful gases such as HCl and H 2 S, and take deodorization and ventilation measures in time.
